name: vision-studio-web
description: YOLO11 detection / segmentation / pose / OBB / classification, YOLO-World open-vocabulary detection, Segment Anything, SegFormer and Depth Anything V2 — all in the browser on ONNX Runtime Web (WebGPU + multi-threaded WASM), inside a Web Worker.

scripts.check: node --check app.js && for f in src/*.js src/tasks/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo ok
